problemSigns.detail: You hear metallic scraping or high-pitched sounds as the garage door moves.
The door moves unevenly or shakes within its tracks during operation.
Inspect your rollers; some may have flat areas or appear to move erratically on their axles.
The metal shaft connecting the roller to the hinge shows corrosion or visible damage.

After installation, we perform a balance test on the garage door. We check the safety-reverse mechanism. This ensures proper and safe operation.
We confirm smooth, quiet door movement. We ensure all components are secure. The work area is cleaned.
